definitions.gloss: battledore; wooden paddle used for hanetsuki
definitions.explanation: A wooden paddle used in the traditional New Year game hanetsuki (similar to badminton without a net). Also refers to elaborately decorated paddles sold as good-luck ornaments.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}に{羽子板|はごいた}で{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: We played with battledore paddles at New Year's.

examples.japanese: {浅草寺|せんそうじ}の{羽子板|はごいた}{市|いち}は{毎年|まいとし}{十二月|じゅうにがつ}に{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The battledore fair at Sensoji Temple is held every December.

examples.japanese: {女|おんな}の{子|こ}が{生|う}まれると、{初正月|はつしょうがつ}に{羽子板|はごいた}を{贈|おく}る{風習|ふうしゅう}がある。
examples.english: There is a custom of giving a battledore paddle when a baby girl is born, for her first New Year.

notes:
USAGE:
Decorated {羽子板|はごいた} are sold at year-end markets, most famously at the {浅草寺|せんそうじ}{羽子板|はごいた}{市|いち} (Sensoji Battledore Fair) in December. These ornamental paddles feature elaborate designs, often depicting kabuki actors, and are displayed as good-luck charms rather than used for play.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽子板|はごいた}{市|いち} (battledore fair)
- {飾|かざ}り{羽子板|はごいた} (decorative battledore)
- {羽根|はね}つき (hanetsuki — the game played with a battledore)
